title: 30A Beach House Under The Palms Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Pet friendly beach house rental, Under the Palms, located in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4 bathroom vacation complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Pet friendly beach house rental, Under the Palms, located in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 4 bathroom vacation complete with all of the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 5 Bedrooms/4 Bathrooms/1 Half Bathroom * Pet Friendly * Backyard with Tropical Oasis* Seasonal Outdoor Sauna* Open Air Balconies* Large Living Area - 65" Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Outdoor Seating, Grill and Firepit* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 45" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, 35" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 4 - Bunk Bed (Twin over Full)* Bathroom 4 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 5 - Bunk Bed (Twin over Full)* Half Bathroom on Main Level* Laundry Room - Full Size Washer and Dryer* Outdoor Shower, Garden Fountain and Firepit* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* 4 Bikes Included* Sleeps 12 Walking Distance to Greenway Station, Seagrove Beach Access - 2 Best Access Points: Ramsgate Beach .5 miles away and Eastern Lake Beach is 0.3 miles away. 30A Public Beach Access Points ABOUT THE AREANestled in the heart of Florida's iconic 30A, Santa Rosa Beach is a picturesque coastal community known for its sugar-white sand beaches, turquoise waters, and charming neighborhoods. This area offers an unparalleled vacation experience, blending natural beauty with a vibrant local culture. Explore the serenity of Grayton Beach State Park and Point Washington State Forest, perfect for hiking, biking, and kayaking. Stroll or bike along 30A's scenic pathway to discover charming beach towns like Seaside, WaterColor, and Rosemary Beach, each brimming with unique dining, boutique shopping, and cultural attractions. Foodies will delight in the area’s culinary offerings, including fresh seafood and locally inspired cuisines. For family-friendly fun, enjoy pristine beaches, explore local art galleries, or unwind with live music under the stars.Whether seeking adventure or relaxation, Santa Rosa Beach on 30A is the ideal destination for a memorable coastal getaway. Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
